## Tar Dream Meaning

This is a wonderful dream.

You will fall deeply in love. For some time, it will seem to you that this love is unattainable.

You will suffer and feel distressed. But soon you will have an unexpected meeting with that person and realize that they have feelings for you.

Gradually, your relationship will grow warmer, and both of you will feel happy.

If in your dream you heard a tar being played, you will be separated from your beloved and experience deep sorrow and a sense of loss, but this separation will not last long.

Your beloved will return and confess that life without you is difficult.
published.description: Dreaming of a tar, the musical instrument, traditionally points to serious love that may first seem unattainable. Hearing it played can signify a painful but temporary separation.
published.title: Tar Musical Instrument Dream Meaning
